subject: Final MAP steps: POC environment wiring and close timeline (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@medialabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC environment wiring - next actions and timeline

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. I captured the MAP items we agreed for the POC environment and the actionable owners below. Goal is to get the environment greenlit and start load tests the week of Apr 27. Please confirm the IP ranges and the peering window that work for your network team so we can lock dates.

Quick checklist (what Redwood will deliver / what Medialabs owns):
- Redwood: provision eval org and create two API keys (staging / integration). Attach: redwood-map-v1.3.pdf (MAP checklist).
- Medialabs: confirm org-level SSO/SCIM decisions (if needed) and provide list of service accounts to be whitelisted.
- IP allowlist: we need your public egress CIDRs for the VPC peering tunnel.
- VPC peering: proposed window Apr 22–23 (2 hours outage risk window). Karthik will share the peering template and required routes.

Can you confirm: 1) the three /24 ranges you can provision for allowlist, 2) whether you want us to create the initial service account, and 3) if Apr 22 peering window is acceptable?

If that all looks good I will send a short MOU and a DocuSign for the MAP acceptance (non-binding timeline).

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-map-v1.3.pdf
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@medialabs.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Grant <bob.grant@medialabs.com>, Medialabs Network Team <netops@medialabs.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment wiring - next actions and timeline

Hi Priya —

Thanks, this looks good. Quick answers below — copying our network lead Bob and netops so they can confirm the CIDR allocation and schedule.

1) IP ranges (public egress NAT IPs): 34.201.128.0/24, 35.182.64.0/24, 18.205.16.0/24. We'll validate with netops and confirm final NAT IPs by Apr 19.
2) Service account: we prefer Redwood to create the initial service account that we will later rotate to our managed account. Please create with the display name 'medialabs-redwood-poc'.
3) Peering window: Apr 22 is tight for our change window, Apr 23 (US evening) would be safer; we can do a 2-hour window starting 22:00 PDT.

One ask: can you provide the exact IAM policy JSON fragment we should expect for the service account and the sample route table entries? That will speed internal approvals.

Best,
Alice
Alice Chen
Head of Product, Medialabs Inc.
alice.chen@medialabs.com

Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment wiring - next actions and timeline

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Short answers and attachments: I've attached vpc-peering-template.txt and a small IAM snippet below.

IAM: (minimal roles for the initial service account)
- roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1 (list instances for debugging)
- roles/iam.serviceAccountUser (to allow token exchange)
- roles/logging.logWriter (for diagnostic logs)

Route entries: add a route for 10.0.0.0/16 -> peering connection (replace with the actual VPC CIDR you provide). For the NAT IPs you listed, we only need the public CIDRs on the allowlist (we will annotate the traffic flows in the MAP doc).

Timing: Apr 23 22:00–00:00 PDT works for us. Kicking off the peering will require a small config change on both sides; expect a 10–15 minute traffic validation, then a 30–45 minute soak while we run connectivity tests and a small sample inference run. If everything passes we will hand the environment over to your SRE to start load tests.

Marissa will follow up with the DocuSign and the final MAP PDF with annotated steps.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Infra Eng Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: vpc-peering-template.txt

Hi Alice / Bob —

All noted and thank you. Summary of agreed timeline and next steps: 
- Apr 19: Medialabs confirms final NAT IPs (Alice/Bob).
- Apr 20: Redwood creates service account 'medialabs-redwood-poc' and uploads IAM fragment to the MAP doc.
- Apr 22: Redwood sends DocuSign MOU for signature (non-binding timeline).
- Apr 23 22:00–00:00 PDT: VPC peering change window (netops to execute, Redwood to validate).
- Apr 27: Start small load/latency tests (Medialabs to validate features).

Marissa — please send the DocuSign and the annotated MAP (final) by EOD today so Alice can loop in procurement. Alice — once Nat IPs are confirmed we'll upload medialabs-ip-list.csv to the shared Drive link and schedule the peering runbook call with NetOps.

If there are any blockers on procurement / SSO we should surface them by Apr 20 so they don't push past the peering date.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting this live.

Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
